statement.p: For how many n \in \{1,2, \ldots, 790\} is n a multiple of one or more of 8, 5, or 9?

hint.p: To find out how many numbers are divisible by 8 and 9, for example, take 790/(8\cdot9) and round down.

solution.p: 299 values of n\text{.} Use PIE: 98 + 158+ 87 - (19 + 10 + 17) + 2 or a Venn diagram. To find out how many numbers are divisible by 5 and 9, for example, take 790/(5\cdot9) and round down.
